blocks.text: We are building more than headphones.

The High Frequency Marketplace is where the rest of the practice lives. Everything in it does one job: raise the signal your brain runs on. The headphones were the first tool. They tune your state in under sixty seconds, and over 100,000 people have felt it.
But a session ends and your brain keeps running. We could tune the instrument. We could not do anything about what it was running on.
That gap is what the marketplace exists to close. The practice grows from here.
This is the first product in it. You are seeing it before it goes anywhere else.
Every frequency you feel in those headphones is your neurons firing.
And neurons fire by moving charged minerals across a membrane. That is what the signal physically is.
So we went looking for the richest source of those minerals on earth. We found it at 16,000 feet.

Shilajit is a mineral essence the Himalayas spend centuries making, pressed out of ancient plant matter between layers of rock. It seeps from the cliffs in summer, when the sun warms them. People have climbed up and gathered it by hand for thousands of years, and Ayurvedic practice has used it that entire time. The old Sanskrit name translates to destroyer of weakness.

It carries 85+ trace minerals in ionic form, the charged form your cells absorb directly, plus a compound called fulvic acid that helps your cells turn fuel into energy. Modern food, grown in tired soil, barely delivers either one.
Raw, it is bitter and hard to take. So we folded it into caramel honey.
Tune the signal. Feed the signal.
This is a compounding mineral, never a stimulant. Nothing spikes on day one. Here is the arc people consistently report.

items.label: Week 1
items.text: Steadier energy through the day, deeper sleep at night. The afternoon crash starts to fade.

items.label: Week 2
items.text: The fog lifts. Focus holds through the afternoon without rescue.

items.label: Week 4
items.text: Faster recovery between workouts. More output, less soreness.

items.label: Weeks 8 to 12
items.text: The full compound effect. In a 90-day double-blind, placebo-controlled study of 96 men aged 45 to 55, purified shilajit raised total testosterone 20% (Andrologia, 2016).

blocks.text: That is the same philosophy you bought the headphones for. Coffee borrows energy and bills you at 2 PM. Minerals build it.
The mechanisms are not sex-specific. Mitochondrial energy, mineral absorption, and clarity apply to women too. The study above was run on men, so we cite it as what it is.
All of which only works if you actually take it, which is the entire reason this is honey and not a jar of resin.
Tear the stick at the top notch. No scissors, no measuring, no mess.
Squeeze it straight into your mouth, or stir it into tea, coffee, or warm water. Caramel first, then something mineral underneath.
Then put the headphones on. Ten seconds of honey, sixty seconds of frequency. That is the whole ritual, and that is how you start your morning on the high frequency.

Morning works best, or about thirty minutes before a workout. The only thing that really matters is doing it daily, because the benefits compound rather than arriving all at once. Miss a day and just continue the next one. Do not double up.

blocks.text: Before you take it

Adults 18 and over. Talk to your doctor first if you are pregnant, nursing, trying to conceive, on prescription medication, or managing a diagnosed condition. Shilajit contains iron and may not suit people with iron-overload conditions. Contains honey, so not for infants under 12 months. If you are managing blood sugar, note the 6.6g of honey sugar per stick.
